title: Senior Frontend Developer "976706"
description:
Quem Somos


A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.

Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 60 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de soluções de staffing, soluções de TI e complementação de força de trabalho. Estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, projetos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação. Apoiamos nossos clientes para encontrar a melhor maneira que seu gap de talentos seja endereçado, de maneira a suportar seu processo de transformação digital. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.

O que esperar de nós


Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparência, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. A Dexian está comprometida com a responsabilidade social corporativa e, investe em programas que apoiam a diversidade e inclusão.

Se você compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar!

O que esperar do seu dia a dia de trabalho


Desenvolver interfaces de usuário visualmente atraentes e funcionalmente eficientes.

Criar aplicações web bem arquitetadas, responsivas e de alto desempenho.

Construir código e bibliotecas reutilizáveis para uso futuro.

Garantir a viabilidade técnica dos designs de UI/UX.

Otimizar aplicações para máxima velocidade e escalabilidade.

Colaborar com o time de design utilizando ferramentas como Figma, Sketch e outras.

Participar de sessões de brainstorming e outras atividades de geração de ideias com a equipe.

Implementar padrões de desenvolvimento e seguir as melhores práticas.


O que você precisa ter

  • React;
  • Redux;
  • JavaScript;
  • HTML;
  • Inglês avançado para conversação.


Onde você vai trabalhar


No conforto da sua casa, regime 100% remoto!

title: Remote Data Scientist (ML) - 52621
description:
About Turing:

Turing is one of the world’s fastest-growing AI companies accelerating the advancement and deployment of powerful AI systems. Turing helps customers in two ways: Working with the world’s leading AI labs to advance frontier model capabilities in thinking, reasoning, coding, agentic behavior, multimodality, multilinguality, STEM and frontier knowledge; and leveraging that work to build real-world AI systems that solve mission-critical priorities for companies.


Role Overview:

We’re looking for a Data Scientist who has excellent hands on Python skills and Machine Learning experience — someone who lives and breathes code, optimizes for performance, and has proven mastery on competitive programming or data challenge platforms like LeetCode, Codeforces, HackerRank, or Kaggle . In this role you will be working with Turing team members and AI researchers at Frontier Labs to devise techniques and build data sets to improve performance of models.


What You’ll Do:

  • Build, test, and optimize high-performance Python systems used in large-scale AI and data pipelines.
  • Design and maintain modular, clean, and production-ready Python codebases.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams (data, infra, and research engineers) to deliver reliable backend components.
  • Write efficient, maintainable, and testable code with strong focus on algorithms and data structures .
  • Stay current with modern Python tools, frameworks, ML advancements and best practices.


Required Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field.
  • 4+ years of professional experience writing Python in production environments.
  • Expert-level proficiency in Python and core libraries (Pandas, NumPy, AsyncIO, Pytorch, Transformers, or similar).
  • Proven track record on coding platforms — e.g., top percentile or strong rating on LeetCode, Codeforces, HackerRank, or Kaggle competitions.
  • Experience with system design, clean architecture, and performance optimization.
  • Working level Proficiency in either Machine Learning or Data Science for Machine Learning.


Bonus:

  • Recognized performance in Kaggle , Codeforces , or ICPC/TopCoder contests.
  • Deep curiosity for performance tuning, scalability, and elegant code design.


Perks of Freelancing with Turing:

  • Work fully remotely, from anywhere.
  • Collaborate with world-class AI labs and frontier research companies .
  • Tackle real engineering challenges with high autonomy and ownership.


Offer Details:

  • Commitment: Minimum 20 hours/week with 4-hour PST overlap (options: 20, 30, or 40 hrs/week).
  • Type: Contractor (no medical/paid leave).
  • Duration: 3 months (start date: next week).


Evaluation Process:

  • Technical Interview (60 mins): discussion of Python problem-solving, architecture, and system design.


After applying, you’ll receive a login link by email. Please complete your profile promptly so we can proceed with your application.


We’re actively hiring for this role. If you know exceptional talent, please refer them at turing.com/referrals and earn money for successful referrals.

title: English Teacher with Advanced Portuguese Skills
description:
Are you a Portuguese speaker who graduated as an English Teacher? We are looking for you!

Teach fun English classes online via Zoom from the comfort of your own home! You can set your own hours and teach on the go as long as you have a solid color backdrop, a laptop, good WiFi, a webcam, and a microphone.


If you love teaching, but dread prepping for lessons and grading, this is the perfect job for you. We provide our teachers with all the lesson materials so all you have to do is show up for class and do what you do best, which is teach!

Whether you’re looking for a second stream of income or a full-time job, we’ve got you covered. You can work as little as 16 hours a month up to as much as 30 hours a week.


What is a typical day for an Online English Teacher at LatinHire?

You will be scheduled shifts two weeks in advance according to the availability you provide us and we also offer the flexibility of dropping shifts and picking up extra shifts.

If you are busier one week, you can drop some of your shifts and have other teachers help you out or if you want to earn more $$ another week, you can pick up extra shifts and help other teachers out.

When you are on shift, you log on to our platform and teach the lessons provided as well as write short feedback for the students after class. Simple as that!


In short, here are some reasons why you will love working as an Online English Teacher with LatinHire:


  • Up to 30 hours of shifts available per week!
  • You be your own boss and set your own schedule
  • Work from anywhere (as long as you have good WiFi, workspace, computer, webcam, and microphone).
  • Depending on the number of hours you decide to teach and on your schedule, you can earn up to USD 900+ per month.


Minimum Requirements:


  • Portuguese as a first language.
  • C1 or C2 Level English Speaker
  • University degree in English Teaching or related area.
  • One year of experience in teaching English as a foreign language.
  • Access to a computer with a reliable, high-speed (at least 2MB) internet connection.
  • Must pass a criminal background check.
  • Teachers must provide at least ten (10) hours of weekly availability.


Who we are:

Established in 2003, LatinHire recruits and manages teams of subject matter experts (SMEs) for online education companies. For over 20 years, our teams have played key roles in the backend of very successful educational startups.

title: Influencer Manager
description:
Apollo Growth is an industry-leading growth marketing agency specializing in media buying, creative production, and full-service marketing. We help brands scale efficiently with data-driven strategies and high-impact creative.


Role Overview

We’re looking for an Influencer Manager to build, manage, and scale creator programs for our clients across organic social.


What you’ll do

• Seed and maintain influencer/creator lists tailored to each client and vertical

• Own creator outreach, relationship management, and deal negotiations

• Coordinate posting timelines, deliverables, and approvals across creators

• Track performance (engagement, clicks, conversions) and report learnings

• Provide creative direction and real-time feedback to creators based on what’s trending and performing


What we’re looking for

• Strong understanding of creator-led growth and performance content

• Comfortable negotiating rates, usage rights, and whitelisting terms

• Highly organized with strong follow-through and communication

• Data-aware: you care about what performs, not just what looks good


Requirements

  • 2+ years of experience in influencer marketing, affiliate marketing, or general marketing.
  • Experience with Google Sheets, Excel, and basic data visualization.
  • Familiarity with advertising platforms (Meta Ads, Google Ads) is a requirement.
  • Fluency in English (strong written and verbal communication skills).
  • Extreme attention to detail – You triple-check your work and ensure everything is executed flawlessly.


Why Join Apollo Growth?

  • Work directly with the CEO in a fast-growing, high-impact marketing agency.
  • Gain hands-on experience in digital marketing and media buying.
  • Remote-friendly, flexible work environment.
  • Opportunity to grow and take on more responsibility over time.


Ready to join us? Apply now and help us scale some of the world’s top brands!

title: Analista de Suporte à Gestão Ágil (SAFe / ARTs)
description:
Sobre nós

A Atos é uma líder global em transformação digital, com cerca de 94.000 colaboradores e uma receita anual de aproximadamente €11 bilhões de euros. Número um na Europa em cibersegurança, nuvem e computação de alto desempenho, o Grupo oferece soluções personalizadas de ponta a ponta para todos os setores em 69 países. Pioneira em serviços e produtos de descarbonização, a Atos está comprometida com um ambiente digital seguro e descarbonizado para seus clientes. A Atos é uma SE (Societas Europaea) e está listada na Euronext Paris.


Sobre a vaga:


Você tem familiaridade com SAFe , gosta de ambientes ágeis complexos e quer apoiar grandes times a entregarem valor de forma estruturada e eficiente? Essa vaga pode ser sua!


O que você vai fazer:


  • Suportar o Release Train Engineer (RTE) na gestão e otimização do fluxo de entrega de valor de um Agile Release Train (ART) ;
  • Apoiar a execução dos Program Increments (PI), participando da preparação, realização e retrospectiva de eventos como PI Planning, Scrum of Scrums, PO Syncs, System Demos, Inspect & Adapt ;
  • Elaborar artefatos, atas, relatórios e análises com base em dados extraídos de ferramentas de gestão ágil (burnup, burndown, OKRs, throughput, etc);
  • Apoiar na resolução de impedimentos e no acompanhamento de riscos e dependências;
  • Atuar no acompanhamento financeiro de épicos/features e alimentar sistemas integrados de gestão;
  • Suportar auditorias e controles (como SOX), mantendo a conformidade dos dados operacionais e financeiros;
  • Colaborar com levantamentos de maturidade ágil, DevOps , e apoiar planos de ação de melhoria contínua.


Requisitos:

  • Experiência com suporte à gestão em ambientes ágeis estruturados (Scrum, Kanban, SAFe);
  • Conhecimento no framework SAFe (Scaled Agile Framework) – desejável certificação ;
  • Domínio de ferramentas de gestão ágil e análise de dados operacionais (Jira, Excel avançado, etc);
  • Habilidade para comunicação, elaboração de apresentações e condução de reuniões.


Diferenciais:

  • Certificação SAFe, SAFe Agilist ou similares;
  • Experiência com DevOps , acompanhamento de OKRs e indicadores ágeis;
  • Vivência em empresas de grande porte com múltiplos ARTs ou programas complexos.


O que valorizamos:

  • Perfil colaborativo e comunicativo;
  • Organização e senso de urgência;
  • Comprometimento com segurança da informação e excelência técnica.

title: Senior ABAP Cloud Developer (RAP & BTP Focus)
description:
Location: Remote (Brazil)

Reports to: CTO


Who We Are


COMO Digital Life is a regulated payment institution in Luxembourg, building next-generation financial infrastructure for global businesses. We blend cloud-native technology, rigorous compliance, and elegant engineering to deliver secure, reliable payment solutions.

We're looking for a Senior ABAP Cloud Developer who understands that the future of SAP is not in modifying standard code, but in building robust, cloud-native extensions using the RESTful ABAP Programming Model (RAP), CDS Views, and SAP BTP. If you're ready to leave SE80 behind and embrace Eclipse/ADT, clean core architecture, and API-first development, you'll fit right in.


Your Mission


Your mission is to architect and deliver modern SAP solutions that power our financial operations, payment flows, and compliance reporting. You will champion the Clean Core approach, building upgrade-safe extensions that leverage SAP's latest cloud technologies.

Your work will directly shape the reliability, scalability, and intelligence of COMO's financial ecosystem—using ABAP RAP for transactional processing, CDS Views for high-performance data modeling, and SAP HANA for database-level optimization. You'll also leverage AI-assisted development practices to accelerate delivery and maintain code quality.


What You'll Do


  • Design and develop end-to-end applications using the ABAP RAP model (Managed and Unmanaged scenarios), including behavior definitions, validations, determinations, and actions.
  • Build and optimize CDS View Entities across interface, projection, and consumption layers with proper annotations and authorization via DCL.
  • Architect solutions that strictly adhere to Clean Core principles, utilizing released APIs, side-by-side extensibility on SAP BTP, and Key User Extensibility to keep systems upgrade-safe.
  • Develop high-performance data processing using SQLScript and AMDP, pushing logic to the SAP HANA database layer where appropriate.
  • Expose and consume OData services (V2 and V4), integrating SAP with external fintech platforms using SAP Integration Suite.
  • Conduct code reviews, enforce static code analysis (ATC), and write ABAP Unit tests to ensure financial-grade reliability and security.
  • Apply AI tools in development workflows to accelerate coding, testing, documentation, and optimization.
  • Mentor mid-level developers in the transition from classical ABAP to modern ABAP OO and Cloud methodologies.


What You Bring


  • Education: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or equivalent experience.
  • 5+ years of SAP ABAP development experience with deep expertise in ABAP Objects (OO design, interfaces, exceptions, clean code practices).
  • Proven hands-on experience with ABAP RAP (Behavior Definitions, Service Bindings, EML, transactional processing).
  • Expert-level knowledge of CDS Views including associations, annotations, and layered view design.
  • Experience with SAP BTP for building extensions and services that support clean core architecture.
  • Strong SAP HANA knowledge: SQLScript, AMDP, performance optimization, and database-level troubleshooting.
  • Experience with OData V2 and V4 service development and consumption.
  • Proficiency with Eclipse ADT (ABAP Development Tools) and Git-based version control (abapGit).
  • Professional proficiency in English for technical documentation and international collaboration.


Nice to Have


  • SAP S/4HANA implementation or migration experience.
  • SAP Fiori development experience (Fiori Elements, UI5, UI annotations strategy).
  • Knowledge of SAP CAP (Cloud Application Programming) model for polyglot development.
  • Experience with BTP services: Integration Suite, Event Mesh, Workflow Management, or Build Process Automation.
  • Fintech, banking, or high-volume transaction environment background.
  • Experience with AI-assisted coding tools and practices.


Why Join Us?


  • Work on modern SAP engineering (RAP, CDS, BTP) instead of legacy-heavy maintenance—this is your career pivot into the future of SAP.
  • Build solutions for a regulated fintech where engineering quality, security, and reliability are first-class priorities.
  • True remote work from anywhere in Brazil with international exposure and meaningful ownership of cloud-ready SAP architectures.
  • Influence key automation, reporting, and integration initiatives in a tech-first culture.
  • Continuous learning support for certifications and training to keep you at the bleeding edge of the SAP roadmap.


How to Apply


Send your CV in English to with the subject "Senior ABAP Cloud Developer". Short-listed candidates will be contacted within two weeks.


Recruitment Process


1.      Screening Teams interview with HR (15 min).

2.      Technical conversation with our CTO (30-45 mins) to discuss your experience with RAP, CDS, and modern ABAP practices.


Ready to Join Us?


If you're excited about building cloud-native SAP solutions using RAP and CDS, enjoy solving complex architectural challenges with clean core principles, and want to contribute to a modern fintech leveraging AI and automation at its core - this role is for you.


We look forward to meeting engineers who value clean architecture, upgrade-safe extensibility, and high-quality code.

title: Senior Account Executive
description:
About Warmy.io

Warmy.io is the go-to AI-driven email deliverability platform, helping businesses and individuals improve email deliverability and inbox placement. Our technology is trusted by startups, agencies, and enterprises globally to ensure their emails land in the inbox - not the spam folder.


We’re growing fast and looking for an experienced Account Executive who knows how to close deals, build relationships, and drive revenue in both B2B and B2C markets. If you have a background in SaaS sales, MarTech, and a killer command of English, we want you on board.


About the Role

As an Account Executive, you will manage deals from discovery, to negotiations, to closing the deal. You’ll work with inbound and outbound prospects, demo our product, and craft tailored solutions to help customers improve their email deliverability.


This is a fully remote position with a competitive base salary + commission, offering a real opportunity to grow with a fast-moving SaaS company.


Key Responsibilities

  • Own and manage the entire sales cycle, from initial contact to closing.
  • Conduct discovery calls, demos, and follow-ups to convert prospects into paying customers.
  • Work closely with marketing and customer success to optimize the sales funnel.
  • Develop and execute sales strategies for both B2B and B2C clients.
  • Track and manage deals in CRM (HubSpot, Salesforce, or similar).
  • Stay on top of industry trends, competitors, and market needs to refine sales approaches.
  • Provide feedback to the product team to improve Warmy.io based on customer insights


What We’re Looking For

  • 3+ years of experience in SaaS sales (ideally MarTech, email deliverability, or sales automation). 
  • Proven track record of closing deals and exceeding quotas. 
  • Deep understanding of both B2B and B2C sales cycles. 
  • Excellent English - you can sell, negotiate, and handle objections like a pro. 
  • Experience working with CRM tools (HubSpot, Salesforce, etc.). 
  • Strong communication and presentation skills - you know how to deliver a killer demo. 
  • A data-driven mindset - you track metrics and continuously optimize your approach.


What We Offer

  • Competitive base salary + commission.
  • Fully remote work - flexible, global-friendly environment.
  • High-growth SaaS environment with plenty of learning and career growth opportunities.
  • Work alongside a world-class team in MarTech and email deliverability.
  • Ready to join Warmy.io and make an impact? Apply now and let’s talk!

description:

Turing helps customers in two ways: Working with the world’s leading AI labs to advance frontier model capabilities in thinking, reasoning, coding, agentic behavior, multimodality, multilinguality, STEM and frontier knowledge; and leveraging that work to build real-world AI systems that solve mission-critical priorities for companies.

We’re looking for a Data Scientist who has excellent hands on Python skills and Machine Learning experience — someone who lives and breathes code, optimizes for performance, and has proven mastery on competitive programming or data challenge platforms like LeetCode, Codeforces, HackerRank, or Kaggle .   • Collaborate with world-class AI labs and frontier research companies .

Evaluation Process:

  • Technical Interview (60 mins): discussion of Python problem-solving, architecture, and system design.


After applying, you’ll receive a login link by email. Please complete your profile promptly so we can proceed with your application.


We’re actively hiring for this role. If you know exceptional talent, please refer them at turing.com/referrals and earn money for successful referrals.

title: GOOGLE + MICROSOFT ADS MANAGER (No Quick Applies) — Remote, Full-Time
description:
Hey—I'm Dustin Lunde , CEO of BestLyfe Group (BLG) .


No fluff, No filler:

If your definition of “doing PPC” is turning campaigns on, watching impressions go up, and calling it a win , we’re not compatible.


But if you’re the type who:

  • obsesses over profit, not clicks
  • treats ROAS like a religion
  • knows Microsoft Ads is not “Google’s weird cousin”
  • and thinks “automation” is a verb…

…keep reading. You might be exactly who we’ve been waiting for.


We’re hiring a Google + Microsoft Ads Manager to drive real outcomes for our clients—leads, sales, booked jobs, and revenue . And not just as an operator: in 2026 , this person will help build and lead a small paid search team , meaning you’ll need to know how to train, delegate, and scale people —not just campaigns.


Pay is extremely competitive because we’re not looking for average. We’re looking for a weapon. A kind one. But still a weapon.


Position

Title: Google + Microsoft Ads Manager (Growth Lead Track)

Location: Remote

Status: Full-Time

Start: 2–4 weeks (or sooner if you’re the real deal)


What you’ll be doing (aka how you’ll earn your BLG cape)


Run paid search like a performance business

  • Build, launch, manage, and optimize campaigns across:
  • Google Ads (Search, Performance Max, Display, YouTube where relevant)
  • Microsoft Ads (Search + Audience Network when it makes sense)
  • Own performance outcomes: ROAS, CPL, CAC, MQL→SQL quality, booked calls, revenue


Be the “funnel detective”

  • Audit landing pages, lead flow, tracking, and conversion paths
  • Use GA4, GTM, call tracking, CRM data, heatmaps, and dashboards to find:
  • leaks
  • drop-offs
  • fake conversions
  • and “why is this lead trash?” moments


Make AI + automation part of the operating system


You don’t need to be a developer, but you do need to already speak the language:

  • Use (and improve) automation systems with tools like:
  • Make.com, Zapier, GoHighLevel, ChatGPT
  • Automate:
  • reporting
  • pacing alerts
  • QA checks
  • creative/copy iteration
  • internal handoffs
  • So you spend time optimizing , not playing spreadsheet whack-a-mole.


Build a team in 2026

  • Document processes and turn wins into repeatable playbooks
  • Help hire + train junior buyers/assistants
  • Lead through delegation, coaching, and accountability
  • (If “leadership” to you means “I’ll just do it myself,” we’ll lovingly escort you back to the internet.)


You’re a great fit if…


You’re a proven platform expert

  • You have real experience managing Google + Microsoft Ads
  • You understand:
  • match type strategy
  • query sculpting
  • negative keyword hygiene
  • conversion tracking realities (not fairy tales)
  • budget allocation based on marginal returns
  • You can explain why something worked, not just that it worked.


You’re built like a scientist, not a gambler

  • You test, iterate, and measure like your rent depends on it
  • You make decisions using:
  • data
  • business context
  • and common sense (rare, but we still believe)


You embrace AI & automation like it’s your unfair advantage

  • You actively use AI tools to speed up:
  • ad copy
  • landing page iteration ideas
  • keyword research
  • script drafting
  • analysis and reporting narratives
  • You’re always looking for “how do we do this faster without getting dumber?”


You live our Core Values (without being weird about it)

Excellence in All We Do

You don’t ship sloppy work and call it “version one.”

Commitment & Accountability

You own outcomes, not excuses.

Mutually Beneficial Relationships

You want clients to win and you want the team to win—no ego, no sabotage, no drama.

Learning & Development

You’re not “already good.” You’re getting better constantly.


What success looks like here


  • ROAS increases, CPL/CAC drops, lead quality improves
  • Clients renew because results are undeniable
  • Tracking is clean, reporting is useful, and decisions are faster
  • Automations reduce busy work and your time goes into strategy
  • By 2026, you’re helping lead paid search—not just running it


About BestLyfe Group (BLG)


We’re a no-BS, high-output growth partner for small businesses who want real results—not “marketing activity.”

We blend strategy, paid acquisition, conversion, automation, and leadership to drive measurable outcomes. We move fast, we tell the truth, and we hold a high bar.

title: Senior Software Engineer (LAMP / Angular / JavaScript)
description:
We are looking for a full-time, remote Senior Software Engineer with 5+ years of development experience solving complex technical problems across front-end, back-end, and full-stack technologies, including Angular, to join our U.S. client. The ideal candidate should have experience in server-side logic development, defining and maintaining central databases, and ensuring high performance and request responsiveness. The role will involve transforming UI / UX designs into functional HTML, CSS, and JavaScript (including Angular). The primary application stack is LAMP, comprising the latest versions of PHP, MySQL, and Linux, along with Angular for front-end development. You will also be responsible for integrating Angular components built by co-workers into the application.

Our client provides integrated software and marketing solutions for the hospitality industry, specializing in short-term rental management. Their platform provides vacation rental companies with an enterprise-class Property Management System that integrates booking, guest communications, and financial reporting, all built with partner organization integrations in mind.


Responsibilities

  • Build efficient, testable, and reusable PHP or JavaScript modules
  • Identify solutions to complex problems
  • Solve performance issues and architectural challenges
  • Integrate data storage solutions like MySQL, PostgreSQL, and MongoDB
  • Ensure that the code that you produce passes the SonarCloud quality rules for each pull request
  • Integrate user-facing elements developed by front-end developers, including Angular components
  • Translate UI / UX designs and convert them into working HTML, CSS, and JavaScript, including Angular
  • Analyze, configure, and tune the front-end web application, including Angular performance optimization
  • Be a subject matter expert on web technologies, including Angular
  • Enforce software development standards and mentor junior engineers in Angular development best practices


Required Experience

  • Excellent English communication skills
  • 5+ years of experience in web application development using Angular
  • Strong knowledge of PHP web frameworks and libraries (e.g., Zend Framework, Laminas, Laravel, Symphony, and Doctrine)
  • Understanding of MVC design patterns, front-end technologies (e.g., JavaScript, HTML5, CSS3, and Angular), accessibility and security compliance, scalable application design principles (including Angular architecture and scalability considerations), and user authentication and authorization across multiple systems, servers, and environments
  • Familiarity with SQL and NoSQL databases and their declarative query languages
  • Proficient understanding of code versioning tools, such as Git and GitHub
  • Trustworthy, team-oriented, and transparent


Desired Experience

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or some technical engineering
  • Familiarity with code review and analysis tools, such as SonarCloud
  • Experience with AWS
  • Knowledge of AI toolsets and toolkits


Additional Information

  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter, think big!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with innovative and creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Let's learn from them. Be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual, with no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), one floating day, three sick days, and designated national holidays
  • Start: ASAP


About Velozient

We are a privately held, nearshore software development company providing outsourced development resources to North American companies. Our mission is to offer development talent who enjoy taking on challenging work, want to grow their skills and experiences building software, and excel in a fast-paced, dynamic team environment. We focus on providing world-class remote resources who work as valued members of client teams. If this type of opportunity excites you, then consider joining our team!

  • Analisar e apoiar a sustentação da camada de integração SOA , garantindo a correta troca de dados com sistemas legados;
  • Desenvolver, manter e otimizar procedures, triggers e jobs PL/SQL associados ao ecossistema;
  • Apoiar a equipe na análise de incidentes e problemas em ambientes de desenvolvimento, homologação e produção;
  • Contribuir com análises de performance , ajustes de código e melhorias de estabilidade;
  • Utilizar conhecimentos em Java para atender demandas complementares (APIs, serviços auxiliares, integrações, ferramentas internas ou apoio a outras squads).


Requisitos Obrigatórios:


  • Experiência prática com PeopleSoft CRM PS8 , especialmente em ambientes fortemente customizados;
  • Conhecimento sólido em PeopleTools / PeopleCode e componentes do PeopleSoft;
  • Experiência com Integration Broker , web services SOAP/REST , XML e JSON;
  • Experiência com banco de dados Oracle e PL/SQL (procedures, queries, jobs);
  • Vivência com integrações SOA e comunicação entre sistemas legados;
  • Experiência com manutenção corretiva e suporte a sistemas críticos em produção;
  • Conhecimento em Java , com capacidade de atuar em demandas backend ou de integração;
  • Capacidade de análise técnica , diagnóstico e resolução de problemas complexos.


Requisitos Desejáveis:


  • Conhecimento em PeopleSoft Query e SQR;
  • Vivência com portlets ou frameworks de customização web;
  • Experiência com metodologias ágeis (Scrum / Kanban);
  • Familiaridade com versionamento de código e práticas de DevOps / CI-CD;
  • Conhecimentos básicos de monitoramento e observabilidade de aplicações.

title: Customer Success Analyst
description:
Quem somos?

Com 8 anos de história, a TerraMagna vive a missão de tornar a agricultura tudo aquilo que o mundo precisa que ela seja. Hoje atua como financiadora da cadeia de insumos do agronegócio, visando seu sistema operacional e principal parceiro financeiro. Possui mais de 1 bilhão de reais sob gestão, captou 75 milhões de rodada em investimentos e atua com clientes em todo o Brasil.


A TM Digital é a divisão tecnológica da TerraMagna responsável por levar todas as nossas inovações para o mercado. Nossa jornada começou com a tecnologia, identificamos os desafios comuns do agronegócio e expandimos para o financiamento graças à nossa expertise em gestão de riscos em tempo real, um reflexo da nossa solidez tecnológica. Nosso propósito é fortalecer a cadeia de distribuição de insumos e transformar a maneira como o crédito é concedido e recebido no agronegócio brasileiro. Por isso, dividimos a credibilidade tecnológica que permitiu a TerraMagna se tornar o que é para o mercado agro.


A tecnologia está no centro do que fazemos. Nossas equipes de desenvolvimento, arquitetura de sistemas, banco de dados, experiência do usuário, cibersegurança e data & analytics atuam em conjunto para construir o sistema operacional do agronegócio. Em um setor que se transforma todos os dias, somos reconhecidos por liderar essa mudança com visão estratégica.


Estamos em busca de uma pessoa de Customer Success que queira ir além do atendimento e atue como uma verdadeira parceira estratégica dos nossos clientes. Alguém que construa relações de confiança, entenda profundamente os desafios e objetivos de cada cliente e os ajude a transformar nossas soluções em resultados concretos e duradouros. Essa pessoa será protagonista da jornada do cliente, combinando empatia, visão analítica e mentalidade orientada a valor para identificar oportunidades, antecipar necessidades e impulsionar o sucesso de cada conta. Aqui, Customer Success é sobre impacto real na jornada de crédito, recebimento e cobrança no agro, reflexo de crescimento conjunto e experiências memoráveis.



Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Atuar na gestão da carteira de clientes, assegurando engajamento, satisfação e sucesso na utilização dos serviços/produtos;
  • Realizar reuniões de onboarding, acompanhamento e alinhamentos periódicos (QBR, NPS, etc.);
  • Ser a voz do cliente internamente, identificando pontos de melhoria e repassando feedbacks para times internos;
  • Monitorar indicadores de performance, expansão de receita e saúde da conta;
  • Antecipar riscos e agir proativamente para garantir renovação dos contratos;
  • Construir relacionamento consultivo, identificando oportunidades de upsell e cross-sell;
  • Apoiar o cliente no planejamento e execução das melhores práticas de uso da plataforma/serviço;
  • Registrar informações e interações em sistemas internos (CRM).


Requisitos

  • Experiência prévia em Customer Success, Suporte ao Cliente, Atendimento ou áreas correlatas;
  • Excelente comunicação verbal e escrita, com postura consultiva;
  • Capacidade analítica para leitura de dados e tomada de decisões;
  • Organização, autonomia e habilidade para gerir múltiplas contas simultaneamente;
  • Conhecimento de ferramentas de CRM (ex: HubSpot, RD Station, etc.);
  • Perfil orientado a resultados e solução de problemas;
  • Conhecimento em sensoriamento remoto e bases fundiárias, com capacidade de interpretar mapas, croquis e informações georreferenciadas;
  • Experiência prévia nas áreas de crédito e/ou cobrança, compreendendo fluxos operacionais, análise de risco e acompanhamento de carteiras;
  • Domínio do Pacote Office, especialmente Excel e PowerPoint, com facilidade para manipulação de dados, geração de relatórios e construção de apresentações
  • Perfil proativo e orientado a desafios, capaz de lidar bem com demandas dinâmicas, encontrar soluções práticas e transformar obstáculos em oportunidades.


Diferenciais

  • Experiência em empresas de tecnologia, startups ou ambiente de alta performance;
  • Conhecimento de metodologias de CS (Health Score, Sucesso do Cliente, Playbooks).


O que temos por aqui:

  • Remuneração compatível com o mercado (PJ);
  • Benefício flexível por meio do cartão Swile;
  • Gympass;
  • Convênio médico Porto Saúde;
  • Convênio odontológico Uniodonto;
  • Modelo de trabalho remoto.

title: Part-time English-speaking Technical Support Representative
description:
Join our fast growing company as a Customer Support Agent (with English C1 language skills).


It is a remote part-time position.


Start date:

Schedule: 8 AM - 8 PM; 8 PM - 8 AM CET, 24/7, day and night shifts. (2 by 2. Two working days, followed by two days of rest) (around 8-10 shifts per month)

Proactively ensure uninterrupted coverage of colleagues’ working

hours, including night shifts, in response to client requests, particularly

during vacations, sick leave, or other absences. All substitutions will be

discussed 24-48h upfront.

At Mindy-Support you have great opportunity to get:


  • Experience in the international company working with people around the globe;
  • Compensation – Rates $5/hours, one 12 hours shift - $60
  • Training will be provided by the company and the client;
  • 20 paid days of vacations and 10 days of sick leaves per year;
  • Management's attention, support and motivation.


Your responsibilities:


● Politely respond to customers’ inquiries in a timely manner;


● Support with technical questions;

● Cooperate with development and QA teams to resolve the

issues from customers;

● Analyze customer requests and suggest improvements

● Develop healthy Customer Relationship

● Keep clients engaged and regularly using products

● Constant follow up on clients and leads: service usage,

issues, renewals

● Maintain a detailed understanding of Valo Motion services,

assist customers with questions and suggest the best

solutions for their needs

● Build customer loyalty and retention

● Resolve customer issues

● Review customer complaints and concerns and seek to

improve all aspects of the customer experience with Valo

Motion

● Build Trust and Transparency with Clients

● Onboards new clients via WhatsApp / Google Meet


You are our perfect candidate if you:


  • Proficiency in written English at the C1 level;
  • Experience with Windows OS will be an advantage;
  • Prior experience in Customer Support , demonstrating a track record of proficiently managing customer relationships and addressing their needs would be a plus
  • Strong problem-resolution skills;
  • Ability to handle sensitive customer information with confidentiality and discretion;
  • Ability to work in a stressful situation, remaining calm, and showing respect and empathy while working with clients;
  • Ability to remain focused while working remotely.


Mindy-Support is a global company. We empower businesses all over the world through providing remote assistants and outsourced teams specialized in customer support, tech support, back office activities, and agile sales and marketing support.


We respect the individuality and culture of each member of our large team, and appreciate the contribution of each employee to support our Customers.


We will be glad to welcome you to our team. Grow your career with Mindy-Support!

title: Consultores de IBM TM1 / Planning Analytics - ATUANDO NOS EUA E CANADÁ
description:
ATENÇÃO: Buscamos apenas profissionais com sólida experiência em consultoria TM1. Nenhuma outra habilidade é necessária, apenas conhecimento em TM1/PAW!!



FANTASTIC NEW JOB BASED IN BRAZIL TO WORK INTO CLIENTS IN THE US & CANADA TORONTO!!


CONTRACT OR PERMANENT -


In this role, you will be responsible for designing and implementing financial planning solutions using IBM Planning Analytics to achieve project success as agreed with customers; deliver technical, functional, and business outcomes of a project and maintaining high standards of professional communication.


Accountabilities include, but are not limited to:


  • Analysis and evaluation of business requirements through a structured methodical approach
  • Define the solution scope, time, cost and risk by translating business requirements into a set of functional and non-functional deliverables.
  • Estimate and plan project deliverables and success criteria
  • Identify project Risks and Assumptions
  • Communicate with stakeholders, business and technical project teams to ensure the roles and responsibilities for the solution deliver are understood
  • Implementation of financial planning solutions in IBM Planning Analytics / TM1 as designed in the solution scope definition
  • Identify all potential Change Requests and work with designated Principal Consultant/ Project Manager on these variations
  • Participate in Post Implementation Review and assume ownership of any actions


Desired Skills and Experience


Essential


  • Greater than 5 years’ experience in delivering financial planning applications (IBM Planning Analytics / TM1 will be highly valued);
  • Minimum education level of Bachelor’s degree or equivalent in a relevant subject – Engineering, Mathematics, Computer Science, Business, Finance & Accounting;
  • Proven project experience delivering financial planning solutions covering most phases of the project lifecycle including scoping, requirements gathering, design, development, testing and deployment while using project management methodologies;
  • In-depth knowledge and senior level expertise in IBM Planning Analytics / TM1 including cube design, turbo integrator processes & rule engine; IBM Cognos TM1 Certified Developer would be an added advantage;
  • A genuine talent for grasping complex business problems and engineering effective solutions;
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills


Highly Regarded


  • Background in finance and understanding of financial processes such as budgeting & forecasting or supply chain roles is desirable;
  • Well developed skills/ability researching, designing and implementing customer solutions and programs;
  • Strong relationship management;
  • Ability to identify opportunities and taking action to help achieve business goals;
  • Ability to identify process improvement opportunities;
  • Team player with a professional, pro-active approach
  • Citizenship is highly regarded but not essential.

title: Tech Lead .NET Core
description:
Sobre a BRQ Digital

Código da oportunidade: 56624


Há 32 anos no mercado, a BRQ Digital Solutions se consolidou como uma das maiores empresas de transformação digital do país. Com uma plataforma de serviços end to end, oferecemos as mais eficientes e inovadoras soluções, tecnologias e metodologias, promovendo uma jornada de transformação para grandes marcas, de diferentes segmentos, no Brasil e no exterior.

Temos 2.500 funcionários e a empresa é destaque como um dos melhores lugares para trabalhar pelo GPTW e Glassdoor.


BRQ WAY

No nosso BRQ WAY temos a missão de conectar, transformar e empoderar cada um dos nossos profissionais, que por aqui são chamados de feras, para que todos tenham a chance de usar sua paixão para transformar o mundo com tecnologia!

É isso que queremos, com nosso Programa de Diversidade e Inclusão trabalhamos com dois objetivos: equidade e inclusão, buscamos aumentar a participação dos grupos minoritários, quebrar os vieses inconscientes e expandir a conscientização sobre temas tão importantes para que todos sejam livres para serem quem são.

Vamos transformar juntos! Vem ser fera com a gente.


- O que procuramos?

Buscamos um #fera com espírito empreendedor e que sabe que é o verdadeiro protagonista do seu sucesso! Queremos em nosso time pessoas motivadas por desafios, constante evolução e, claro, que são apaixonadas por tecnologia e transformação!


- O que você deve ter?


  • Experiência sólida com .NET Core / .NET 6+ .
  • Conhecimento em APIs REST , gRPC, WebAPI e boas práticas de design (DDD, SOLID).
  • Experiência com Entity Framework , LINQ , e integração com bancos relacionais (SQL Server) e NoSQL.
  • Domínio de React.js , Hooks , Context API , e boas práticas de componentização.
  • Experiência com Microfrontends (ex.: Module Federation).
  • Conhecimento em TypeScript , Webpack , CSS-in-JS .
  • Autenticação JWT com OAuth2, SAML (desejável)


  • Arquitetura:
  • Experiência comprovada com microserviços e event-driven architecture .
  • Conhecimento em mensageria (ex.: RabbitMQ, Kafka).
  • Padrões de observabilidade (logs, métricas, tracing).
  • Experiencia com integração com sistemas


  • Cloud (AWS):
  • Experiência com ECS/EKS , Lambda , API Gateway , S3 , CloudWatch , RDS/DynamoDB .
  • Infraestrutura como código (Terraform ou AWS CDK ).
  • Conhecimento em CI/CD (GitHub Actions, AWS CodePipeline, GitLab).


  • DevOps & Qualidade:
  • Integração contínua, pipelines de build/deploy.
  • Testes automatizados (unitários, integração, end-to-end).
  • Monitoramento e escalabilidade.



- O que temos pra te oferecer?

Mais do que um plano de carreira!

A BRQ acredita que cada fera deve ser protagonista do seu crescimento, tendo autonomia para criar seu próprio plano de desenvolvimento profissional. Nosso plano de carreira é dividido em 4 pilares:

Carreira técnica: Você pode seguir a trilha de crescimento técnico, se o seu objetivo for se desenvolver cada vez mais em diferentes tecnologias. Oferecemos diversos treinamentos!

Carreira de Liderança: Você pode seguir a trilha e se tornar um líder, desenvolver pessoas, auxiliar na evolução profissional e pessoal e estimular o crescimento para o surgimento de novos talentos.

Experiência internacional: Estamos crescendo cada vez mais fora do Brasil e você tem possibilidade de atuar em projetos para outros países, ou diretamente nos países onde a BRQ tem sede.

Empreendedorismo: De funcionário para sócio! Temos o Innovation Hub, a Corporate Venture que investe em ideias de profissionais que tenham sinergia com nosso negócio.


- E os benefícios?

Plano de Saúde; Plano Odontológico; Seguro de Vida; Vale Refeição; Vale Alimentação; Horário Flexível; Home Office; Gympass, Telemedicina, Telenutrição, Canal de suporte emocional 24h e muito mais!


- Como é trabalhar na BRQ?

Temos um clima descontraído, diversos programas e eventos internos. Adoramos comemorar! E fazemos isso muito bem! Veja aqui no Youtube: youtube.com/brqdigitalsolutions


Curtiu? Então inscreva-se e venha para o melhor da Transformação Digital com a gente!

Buscamos um #fera com espírito empreendedor e que sabe que é o verdadeiro protagonista do seu sucesso! Queremos em nosso time pessoas motivadas por desafios, constante evolução e, claro, que são apaixonadas por tecnologia e transformação!


- O que você deve ter?


  • Experiência sólida com .NET Core / .NET 6+ .
  • Conhecimento em APIs REST , gRPC, WebAPI e boas práticas de design (DDD, SOLID).
  • Experiência com Entity Framework , LINQ , e integração com bancos relacionais (SQL Server) e NoSQL.
  • Domínio de React.js , Hooks , Context API , e boas práticas de componentização.
  • Experiência com Microfrontends (ex.: Module Federation).
  • Conhecimento em TypeScript , Webpack , CSS-in-JS .
  • Autenticação JWT com OAuth2, SAML (desejável)


  • Arquitetura:
  • Experiência comprovada com microserviços e event-driven architecture .
  • Conhecimento em mensageria (ex.: RabbitMQ, Kafka).
  • Padrões de observabilidade (logs, métricas, tracing).
  • Experiencia com integração com sistemas


  • Cloud (AWS):
  • Experiência com ECS/EKS , Lambda , API Gateway , S3 , CloudWatch , RDS/DynamoDB .
  • Infraestrutura como código (Terraform ou AWS CDK ).
  • Conhecimento em CI/CD (GitHub Actions, AWS CodePipeline, GitLab).


  • DevOps & Qualidade:
  • Integração contínua, pipelines de build/deploy.
  • Testes automatizados (unitários, integração, end-to-end).
  • Monitoramento e escalabilidade.

Mais do que um plano de carreira!

Carreira técnica: Você pode seguir a trilha de crescimento técnico, se o seu objetivo for se desenvolver cada vez mais em diferentes tecnologias. Oferecemos diversos treinamentos!

title: Senior Web Engineer
description:
ABOUT THE ROLE

Join Street Diligence Inc. as a Senior Web Application Engineer, where you will play a key role in architecting and developing high-performance web applications. Your expertise in modern web development—including JavaScript frameworks, reusable UI components, and responsive design—will drive our innovative solutions. While experience with frameworks like Frappe and Django is an asset, we are primarily focused on robust full-stack development that leverages current technologies to build scalable and intuitive applications. A genuine passion for great user experiences is a must.



KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Design and Development:

  • Lead the design and development of complex, scalable web applications using modern JavaScript frameworks (e.g., React, Angular, or Vue) along with backend technologies.
  • Build responsive, accessible, and engaging user interfaces that prioritize excellent user experiences.
  • Maintain a clean, efficient, and sustainable codebase following best practices.

Technical Leadership:

  • Mentor and provide technical guidance on modern web development practices, focusing on component-driven architectures and best coding practices.
  • Help conduct thorough code reviews to ensure high-quality software delivery.
  • Stay informed about emerging technologies and assess their potential to enhance our web development processes.
  • Help establish robust component libraries and expand object composition

Project Management:

  • Collaborate with project managers and cross-functional teams to define project scopes, requirements, and timelines.
  • Lead technical planning and architecture discussions, ensuring that projects meet both business and technical goals.
  • Ensure on-time delivery of projects with a consistent focus on quality.

Testing and Optimization:

  • Develop and implement comprehensive testing strategies to ensure the performance and reliability of our applications.
  • Demonstrate a passion for unit test coverage and behavior tests to maintain a high-quality codebase.
  • Optimize web applications for speed, scalability, and maintainability.
  • Quickly diagnose and resolve complex technical issues.

Collaboration and Communication:

  • Work closely with UX/UI designers to translate design concepts into functional, visually appealing interfaces.
  • Partner with backend engineers to define and implement robust API integrations.
  • Effectively communicate technical concepts to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.


WHAT YOU'LL BRING TO THE TABLE

  • Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.
  • Experience: A minimum of 5 years’ experience in web application development, with strong expertise in both frontend and backend technologies.
  • Technical Skills:
  • Proficient in JavaScript, HTML5, CSS3, and modern JavaScript frameworks (e.g., React, Angular, or Vue).
  • Experience with backend technologies such as Django, Node.js, or similar frameworks.
  • Familiarity with building reusable UI components and integrating third-party APIs.
  • Additional Skills:
  • Strong understanding of SQL database technologies.
  • A passion for great user experiences, unit test coverage, and behavior tests.
  • Excellent problem-solving skills and a drive to build innovative solutions.
  • Outstanding communication skills and the ability to work collaboratively in a fast-paced environment.

title: Cloud Infrastructure Engineer
description:
Avenue Code is the leading software consultancy focused on delivering end-to-end development solutions for digital transformation across every vertical. We’re privately held, profitable, and have been on a solid growth trajectory since day one. We care deeply about our clients, our partners, and our people. We prefer the word ‘partner’ over ‘vendor’, and our investment in professional relationships is a reflection of that philosophy. We pride ourselves on our technical acumen, our collaborative problem-solving ability, and the warm professionalism of our teams.

Avenue Code has been believing in and promoting plurality actions for over 10 years, understanding that recognizing differences and fostering a safe environment, employment opportunities, representation, and support are the best ways to promote an increasingly equitable culture.



About the opportunity:

Remote

We are seeking a motivated DevOps Engineer to support our cloud infrastructure and deployment pipelines in a dynamic environment leveraging Kubernetes, AWS, GCP, Postgres, and Terraform. In this role, you will participate in automating infrastructure provisioning, managing containerized applications, and maintaining CI/CD workflows to ensure smooth and scalable deployments. You will work closely with senior engineers to troubleshoot issues, implement best practices, and enhance system reliability and performance across multi-cloud platforms. This is an excellent opportunity to grow your skills in a fast-paced, collaborative DevOps environment.

This contract position is open to remote candidates outside the United States in North/South America and will report to the Sr. Manager of DevOps Engineering.


Skills/Experience:

Minimum Requirements:

-4-6 years experience in SRE, DevOps, or similar role

-Experience with cloud provider platforms such as AWS or GCP

-Experience with relational databases (e.g., Postgres, MySQL)

-Familiarity with Kubernetes

- Experience with GitOps CI/CD tools (e.g., Harness, Argo, Flux, Jenkins)

- Familiarity with declarative infrastructure-as-code tools (e.g., Terraform, CloudFormation, Pulumi)

-Exposure to logging, monitoring, metrics collection, and observability tools (e.g., DataDog, Prometheus, Grafana, ELK stack, CloudWatch)

- Collaboration with other engineers working primarily in PST


Desired Skills (Nice to Haves):

- Experience with software development and automation in languages beyond shell scripting (e.g., golang, python, elixir, java, etc.)

- Experience with platform development of tools for development, staging, and integration environments

- Experience with debugging performance or networking issues in applications running on Kubernetes

- Experience with audit compliance (e.g., SOX, SOC2, ISO27001, PCI DSS)

- Working knowledge of UNIX-based Operating Systems

-Computer Science or Engineering degree


Avenue Code reinforces its commitment to privacy and to all the principles guaranteed by the most accurate global data protection laws, such as GDPR, LGPD, CCPA and CPRA. The Candidate data shared with Avenue Code will be kept confidential and will not be transmitted to disinterested third parties, nor will it be used for purposes other than the application for open positions. As a Consultancy company, Avenue Code may share your information with its clients and other Companies from the CompassUol Group to which Avenue Code’s consultants are allocated to perform its services.

title: Technical Lead
description:
About Bliss


Mental health is broken for anyone who leaves home.

Therapists don’t speak your language, don’t understand your culture, and 94% of AI systems show 0 cultural awareness. We’re fixing that.


Bliss is building the first culturally intelligent mental health AI, starting with AI-powered Digital Twins of real therapists, designed to bridge language, culture, and lived experience.


We’ve validated our model with strong retention, an active therapist pipeline, and partnerships starting to form across Europe and the US. Backed by Plug&Play and Founder of Slush & Angry Birds.


Now we’re looking for a technical partner who wants to build mission-critical systems from the ground up, fast, thoughtfully, and with meaningful real-world impact.


About the Role


This isn’t a “join a big team and inherit a roadmap” kind of role.


You will:

  • Set the technical direction for Bliss
  • Architect and build the next evolution of our product
  • Lead the development of our AI layer:
  • Therapist Digital Twins
  • Recommendation engine + matching
  • AI companions rooted in cultural nuance
  • Data pipelines & embeddings for knowledge extraction
  • Prototype ideas quickly to validate direction before committing to full builds
  • Build lightweight versions first → scale what works
  • Work directly with the founder to shape product strategy, not just execute it
  • Take ownership for turning a validated concept into a scalable platform


You are the kind of person who prefers building to talking, loves figuring out unknowns, and likes being early when nothing exists yet.


What We're Looking For


Must-Have

  • Strong product thinking: you care why we build, not just how
  • Experience shipping AI-powered features (LLMs, agents, RAG, embeddings, fine-tuning, vector DBs, etc.)
  • Ability to architect clean, scalable systems (even if we start scrappy)
  • Comfortable leading technical decisions and working independently
  • Excited about rapid prototyping and iteration


Nice-to-Have

  • Bubble experience (or willingness to learn fast)
  • Prior startup or 0→1 experience
  • An eye for UX or at least empathy for how users behave
  • Interest in mental health, cultural intelligence, or AI ethics


Why This Matters

We’re not building “yet another therapy app.”

We’re building the infrastructure for culturally aligned mental health worldwide, something global platforms have failed to do for 15+ years. And you would be the person building the core architecture that makes it possible.


What Makes This Role Different

  • Founder-level autonomy: You influence what we build, how we build it, and why.
  • Direct impact: Your work will improve mental health access for communities that have been ignored.
  • 0→1 ownership: You’ll build foundations, not maintain legacy systems.
  • No politics, no bureaucracy: Just execution, iteration, and collaboration.
  • You’re here to co-create a category-defining product.


If this sounds like you…


Apply. Drop your GitHub at Share a project you hacked together at 2am because you had to build it.


We care about how you think, how you build, and how you learn.


Compensation

2000 - 3000 USD + stock options

title: Desenvolvimento Java AWS - Pleno - 124105
description:
Sobre a vaga


Com mais de 35 anos de mercado e localizada em 16 países, a GFT emprega mais de 10.000 pessoas ao redor do mundo sendo 3.000 pessoas no Brasil.

Aqui, a diversidade, a igualdade e a inclusão estão no centro e garantir um ambiente de trabalho seguro para todas as pessoas faz parte de quem somos.

Promovemos uma cultura de desenvolvimento e crescimento pautadas no nosso pilar de Continuous Scaled Learning porque acreditamos o uso inteligente da tecnologia é a chave para o sucesso nesse mundo digital.


O que estamos buscando?


Desenvolvimento Salesforce Sênior


Requisitos:

  • Desenvolvedor Java experiente e com conhecimentos em Amazon Web Services (AWS) para se juntar à nossa equipe de tecnologia. O profissional será responsável pelo desenvolvimento e manutenção de aplicações robustas e escaláveis em Java, integrando-as com serviços na nuvem AWS.
  • Experiência sólida em desenvolvimento com Java 8/ 11+, incluindo frameworks como Spring, Spring boot, Hibernate ou Java EE. Proficiência em AWS, com experiência prática em serviços como EC2, S3, Lambda, RDS, IAM, CloudFormation, CloudWatch, SSM entre outros. Conhecimento em arquitetura de microsserviços e práticas de desenvolvimento orientado a serviços (SOA). Experiência com bancos de dados relacionais e não relacionais (por exemplo, PostgreSQL, MySQL, DynamoDB). Familiaridade com ferramentas de CI/CD e automação, como Jenkins, GitLab CI ou AWS CodePipeline. Conhecimento em containers e orquestração, como Docker, EKS e Kubernetes. Experiência com práticas de DevOps e infraestrutura como código (IaC) utilizando ferramentas como Terraform ou AWS CloudFormation. Habilidade para resolver problemas complexos de forma eficiente e colaborativa. Formação em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia de Software ou áreas relacionadas. Diferenciais: Certificações AWS, como AWS Certified Developer ou AWS Certified Solutions Architect. Experiência com metodologias ágeis (Scrum, Kanban). Conhecimento em segurança na nuvem e boas práticas de proteção de dados. Experiência em desenvolvimento de APIs RESTful. Contribuições para projetos open source ou participação em comunidades técnicas.

Requisitos e Qualificações:

  • Experiência com OmniStudio, aplicando aceleradores prontos para uso e personalizando-os para as necessidades da indústria de energia e serviços públicos;
  • Conhecimento em Business Rule Engine (BRE) para otimização de regras de negócios e processos de precificação complexos;
  • Experiência com Orchestration Management (OM), incluindo decomposição de pedidos e desenvolvimento de planos de orquestração para processos complexos e multi-step;
  • Conhecimento em Contract Lifecycle Management (CLM) será considerado um diferencial, especialmente para gerenciar contratos ao longo de seu ciclo de vida, da criação à renovação e fechamento;


Descrição comportamental:

Procuramos uma pessoa que:

  • Goste de trabalhar em equipe e seja colaborativa em suas atribuições;
  • Tenha coragem para se desafiar e ir além, abraçando novas oportunidades de crescimento;
  • Transforme ideias em soluções criativas e busque qualidade em toda sua rotina;
  • Tenha habilidades de resolução de problemas ;
  • Possua habilidade e se sinta confortável para trabalhar de forma independente e gerenciar o próprio tempo ;
  • Tenha interesse em lidar com situações adversas e inovadoras no âmbito tecnológico.


O que oferecemos:


Cartão multi-benefícios – você escolhe como e onde utilizar;

Bolsas de Estudos para cursos de Graduação, Pós, MBA e Idiomas;

Programas de incentivo à Certificações;

Horário de trabalho flexível;

Plano personalizado de carreira e possibilidade de carreira internacional;

Salários competitivos;

Avaliação de desempenho anual com possibilidade de bonificação;

Gympass;

Previdência Privada;

Auxílio-Creche;

Assistência Médica;

Assistência Odontológica;

Seguro de Vida.


Big enough to deliver – small enough to care.

Turing helps customers in two ways: Working with the world’s leading AI labs to advance frontier model capabilities in thinking, reasoning, coding, agentic behavior, multimodality, multilinguality, STEM and frontier knowledge; and leveraging that work to build real-world AI systems that solve mission-critical priorities for companies.


Role Overview:

We’re looking for a Data Scientist who has excellent hands on Python skills and Machine Learning experience — someone who lives and breathes code, optimizes for performance, and has proven mastery on competitive programming or data challenge platforms like LeetCode, Codeforces, HackerRank, or Kaggle . In this role you will be working with Turing team members and AI researchers at Frontier Labs to devise techniques and build data sets to improve performance of models.


What You’ll Do:

  • Build, test, and optimize high-performance Python systems used in large-scale AI and data pipelines.
  • Design and maintain modular, clean, and production-ready Python codebases.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams (data, infra, and research engineers) to deliver reliable backend components.
  • Write efficient, maintainable, and testable code with strong focus on algorithms and data structures .
  • Stay current with modern Python tools, frameworks, ML advancements and best practices.


Required Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field.
  • 4+ years of professional experience writing Python in production environments.
  • Expert-level proficiency in Python and core libraries (Pandas, NumPy, AsyncIO, Pytorch, Transformers, or similar).
  • Proven track record on coding platforms — e.g., top percentile or strong rating on LeetCode, Codeforces, HackerRank, or Kaggle competitions.
  • Experience with system design, clean architecture, and performance optimization.
  • Working level Proficiency in either Machine Learning or Data Science for Machine Learning.


Bonus:

  • Recognized performance in Kaggle , Codeforces , or ICPC/TopCoder contests.
  • Deep curiosity for performance tuning, scalability, and elegant code design.


Perks of Freelancing with Turing:

  • Work fully remotely, from anywhere.
  • Collaborate with world-class AI labs and frontier research companies .
  • Tackle real engineering challenges with high autonomy and ownership.


Offer Details:

  • Commitment: Minimum 20 hours/week with 4-hour PST overlap (options: 20, 30, or 40 hrs/week).
  • Type: Contractor (no medical/paid leave).
  • Duration: 3 months (start date: next week).


Evaluation Process:

  • Technical Interview (60 mins): discussion of Python problem-solving, architecture, and system design.


After applying, you’ll receive a login link by email. Please complete your profile promptly so we can proceed with your application.


We’re actively hiring for this role. If you know exceptional talent, please refer them at turing.com/referrals and earn money for successful referrals.

title: Technical Lead
description:
About Bliss


Mental health is broken for anyone who leaves home.

Therapists don’t speak your language, don’t understand your culture, and 94% of AI systems show 0 cultural awareness. We’re fixing that.


Bliss is building the first culturally intelligent mental health AI, starting with AI-powered Digital Twins of real therapists, designed to bridge language, culture, and lived experience.


We’ve validated our model with strong retention, an active therapist pipeline, and partnerships starting to form across Europe and the US. Backed by Plug&Play and Founder of Slush & Angry Birds.


Now we’re looking for a technical partner who wants to build mission-critical systems from the ground up, fast, thoughtfully, and with meaningful real-world impact.


About the Role


This isn’t a “join a big team and inherit a roadmap” kind of role.


You will:

  • Set the technical direction for Bliss
  • Architect and build the next evolution of our product
  • Lead the development of our AI layer:
  • Therapist Digital Twins
  • Recommendation engine + matching
  • AI companions rooted in cultural nuance
  • Data pipelines & embeddings for knowledge extraction
  • Prototype ideas quickly to validate direction before committing to full builds
  • Build lightweight versions first → scale what works
  • Work directly with the founder to shape product strategy, not just execute it
  • Take ownership for turning a validated concept into a scalable platform


You are the kind of person who prefers building to talking, loves figuring out unknowns, and likes being early when nothing exists yet.


What We're Looking For


Must-Have

  • Strong product thinking: you care why we build, not just how
  • Experience shipping AI-powered features (LLMs, agents, RAG, embeddings, fine-tuning, vector DBs, etc.)
  • Ability to architect clean, scalable systems (even if we start scrappy)
  • Comfortable leading technical decisions and working independently
  • Excited about rapid prototyping and iteration


Nice-to-Have

  • Bubble experience (or willingness to learn fast)
  • Prior startup or 0→1 experience
  • An eye for UX or at least empathy for how users behave
  • Interest in mental health, cultural intelligence, or AI ethics


Why This Matters

We’re not building “yet another therapy app.”

We’re building the infrastructure for culturally aligned mental health worldwide, something global platforms have failed to do for 15+ years. And you would be the person building the core architecture that makes it possible.


What Makes This Role Different

  • Founder-level autonomy: You influence what we build, how we build it, and why.
  • Direct impact: Your work will improve mental health access for communities that have been ignored.
  • 0→1 ownership: You’ll build foundations, not maintain legacy systems.
  • No politics, no bureaucracy: Just execution, iteration, and collaboration.
  • You’re here to co-create a category-defining product.


If this sounds like you…


Apply. Drop your GitHub at Share a project you hacked together at 2am because you had to build it.


We care about how you think, how you build, and how you learn.


Compensation

2000 - 3000 USD + stock options

title: GOOGLE + MICROSOFT ADS MANAGER (No Quick Applies) — Remote, Full-Time
description:
Hey—I'm Dustin Lunde , CEO of BestLyfe Group (BLG) .


No fluff, No filler:

If your definition of “doing PPC” is turning campaigns on, watching impressions go up, and calling it a win , we’re not compatible.


But if you’re the type who:

  • obsesses over profit, not clicks
  • treats ROAS like a religion
  • knows Microsoft Ads is not “Google’s weird cousin”
  • and thinks “automation” is a verb…

…keep reading. You might be exactly who we’ve been waiting for.


We’re hiring a Google + Microsoft Ads Manager to drive real outcomes for our clients—leads, sales, booked jobs, and revenue . And not just as an operator: in 2026 , this person will help build and lead a small paid search team , meaning you’ll need to know how to train, delegate, and scale people —not just campaigns.


Pay is extremely competitive because we’re not looking for average. We’re looking for a weapon. A kind one. But still a weapon.


Position

Title: Google + Microsoft Ads Manager (Growth Lead Track)

Location: Remote

Status: Full-Time

Start: 2–4 weeks (or sooner if you’re the real deal)


What you’ll be doing (aka how you’ll earn your BLG cape)


Run paid search like a performance business

  • Build, launch, manage, and optimize campaigns across:
  • Google Ads (Search, Performance Max, Display, YouTube where relevant)
  • Microsoft Ads (Search + Audience Network when it makes sense)
  • Own performance outcomes: ROAS, CPL, CAC, MQL→SQL quality, booked calls, revenue


Be the “funnel detective”

  • Audit landing pages, lead flow, tracking, and conversion paths
  • Use GA4, GTM, call tracking, CRM data, heatmaps, and dashboards to find:
  • leaks
  • drop-offs
  • fake conversions
  • and “why is this lead trash?” moments


Make AI + automation part of the operating system


You don’t need to be a developer, but you do need to already speak the language:

  • Use (and improve) automation systems with tools like:
  • Make.com, Zapier, GoHighLevel, ChatGPT
  • Automate:
  • reporting
  • pacing alerts
  • QA checks
  • creative/copy iteration
  • internal handoffs
  • So you spend time optimizing , not playing spreadsheet whack-a-mole.


Build a team in 2026

  • Document processes and turn wins into repeatable playbooks
  • Help hire + train junior buyers/assistants
  • Lead through delegation, coaching, and accountability
  • (If “leadership” to you means “I’ll just do it myself,” we’ll lovingly escort you back to the internet.)


You’re a great fit if…


You’re a proven platform expert

  • You have real experience managing Google + Microsoft Ads
  • You understand:
  • match type strategy
  • query sculpting
  • negative keyword hygiene
  • conversion tracking realities (not fairy tales)
  • budget allocation based on marginal returns
  • You can explain why something worked, not just that it worked.


You’re built like a scientist, not a gambler

  • You test, iterate, and measure like your rent depends on it
  • You make decisions using:
  • data
  • business context
  • and common sense (rare, but we still believe)


You embrace AI & automation like it’s your unfair advantage

  • You actively use AI tools to speed up:
  • ad copy
  • landing page iteration ideas
  • keyword research
  • script drafting
  • analysis and reporting narratives
  • You’re always looking for “how do we do this faster without getting dumber?”


You live our Core Values (without being weird about it)

Excellence in All We Do

You don’t ship sloppy work and call it “version one.”

Commitment & Accountability

You own outcomes, not excuses.

Mutually Beneficial Relationships

You want clients to win and you want the team to win—no ego, no sabotage, no drama.

Learning & Development

You’re not “already good.” You’re getting better constantly.


What success looks like here


  • ROAS increases, CPL/CAC drops, lead quality improves
  • Clients renew because results are undeniable
  • Tracking is clean, reporting is useful, and decisions are faster
  • Automations reduce busy work and your time goes into strategy
  • By 2026, you’re helping lead paid search—not just running it


About BestLyfe Group (BLG)


We’re a no-BS, high-output growth partner for small businesses who want real results—not “marketing activity.”

We blend strategy, paid acquisition, conversion, automation, and leadership to drive measurable outcomes. We move fast, we tell the truth, and we hold a high bar.

If you’re looking for comfort, predictability, and low standards—this will feel like CrossFit.

If you’re looking to level up, build a career moat, and be part of a team that actually executes—welcome home.


Perks & Culture


  • 100% remote
  • Access to best-in-class tools (AI, automation, reporting, creative systems)
  • Fast-paced environment with direct feedback and high trust
  • Clear path into leadership as we scale in 2026
  • A team that values ownership, humor, transparency, and performance


Ready to apply?


Apply on LinkedIn and then email me: with:

1. A case study or example showing your Google/Microsoft results (wins or lessons—both are valuable)

2. A quick example of:

  • ad copy, or
  • account audit insight, or
  • funnel/landing page recommendations you’ve made

3. A short note answering:

Why BLG?

How do you see yourself growing into leadership by 2026?

4. Your CV + LinkedIn profile


What happens after you apply (so there are no surprises)

If we like what we see, we’ll send you a short video screener.

No trick questions. No corporate nonsense.

Just a chance for us to see how you think, communicate, and show up—because culture, clarity, and ownership matter here.

If the video feels aligned, we’ll move forward to a proper interview.

If not, no harm, no ghosting, no weird energy.

Simple. Human. Efficient. Very BLG.


We’re building something serious.

If you’re ready to help businesses win and become a sharper, more valuable operator and leader…

Let’s go.


— Dustin Lunde

CEO, BestLyfe Group

title: Sr. Full-Stack Software Engineer
description:
*Native/Bilingual English is required for this role (read/written/spoken)


Please upload your CV Resume in English.


Monthly salary: $5,000 - $6,000 USD


Along with our partner, we are seeking a highly capable and experienced Full-Stack Software Engineer to join their team. This role is ideal for a senior-level engineer who thrives on owning features end-to-end, from database schema design to frontend UI implementation.


This is a critical role that requires a solid grasp of modern, decoupled architecture and the ability to work effectively across the entire stack.


Key Responsibilities:

  • End-to-End Feature Development:  Design, build, and deploy new features and services across their product suite, ensuring high performance, responsiveness, and reliability.
  • Backend Engineering:  Develop and maintain core backend services using GoLang, implement efficient and scalable APIs using GraphQL, and manage their relational data infrastructure on Postgres.
  • Frontend Development:  Build intuitive, performant, and engaging user interfaces using Angular and Typescript, specifically focusing on internal dashboards, content management tools, and data visualization applications.
  • Cloud Infrastructure:  Utilize GCP (Google Cloud Platform) services to deploy, monitor, and scale their applications (e.g., Compute Engine, Cloud Run, Cloud SQL).
  • Architectural Contributions:  Collaborate with the team on architectural decisions, ensuring their systems are secure, maintainable, and designed for long-term scalability.


Qualifications:

Required:

  • Experience:  6-10 years of professional software development experience, ideally in a full-stack capacity.
  • Backend Expertise:  Strong proficiency with GoLang (Go) for developing performant microservices and APIs.
  • Database : Deep experience with Postgres (PostgreSQL), including advanced SQL, performance tuning, and database schema design.
  • Frontend Mastery:  Proven experience with JavaScript frameworks and Typescript to build complex, enterprise-grade web applications. Angular proficiency is preferred; otherwise, willingness to learn it is a must.
  • API Design:  Experience designing, building, and consuming APIs, with a preference for GraphQL.
  • Cloud Platform:  Hands-on experience deploying and managing applications on GCP (Google Cloud Platform) or another major cloud provider.


Preferred (Bonus Points):

  • Startup/Early Stage Experience:  Previous experience working in a small, fast-paced environment (e.g., on a team of 1-2 engineers), where independent problem-solving and wearing multiple hats were essential.
  • Media or Retail Tech:  Familiarity with concepts in AdTech, digital signage, content delivery networks (CDNs), or retail/CPG data environments.


Benefits:

  • A fully remote position with a structured schedule that supports work-life balance.
  • The opportunity to contribute to a cutting-edge company revolutionizing in-store digital media and data-driven storytelling.
  • Two weeks of paid vacation per year.
  • 10 paid days for local holidays.


*Please note our partner is only looking for full-time dedicated team members who are eager to fully integrate within their team.

title: Customer Onboarding Specialist
description:
We’re expanding our Customer Success team and hiring a high-performing Onboarding Specialist. You will own the customers' first 30 - 45 days, set the tone for the relationship, build confidence and ensure customers are ready quickly and correctly. This role defines the customer’s first impression of Smarter Contact and has clear growth potential within a fast-scaling SaaS company. This is a direct-hire role.


About us:

Smarter Contact is the market-leading AI-powered communications platform for real estate professionals in the U.S., powering tens of millions of text and voice conversations every month, helping real estate professionals close more deals.



What You’ll Own:

  • Lead and follow up on all 1-1 or group onboarding sessions via phone, video, text, and email using our own tech stack
  • Complete all daily CRM tasks (to-dos, emails, texts, calls, etc.)
  • Guide customers through initial setup, configuration, and first live campaigns
  • Establish clear expectations for SMS performance, compliance, and best practices
  • Reinforce Smarter Contact’s value proposition, positioning, and differentiators
  • Ensure customers reach defined activation milestones within the onboarding window
  • Proactively identify confusion, friction, or risk during onboarding-escalate and resolve

  • Partner closely with Sales, Marketing, and Customer Experience to ensure a clean transition post onboarding
  • Work a minimum of 40 hours/week between 10 AM - 7 pm Eastern Standard Time or later, Monday to Friday
